source.commitToTreeBoundary: Caller supplies the remote tree obtained for expectedCommit; offline verification binds all payload blobs to that supplied tree.

browser.policy: isExpectedOfflineBtcRefresh plus the existing failed UI and retained archive witnesses; numeric quote checked only for outlook

capacityDailyContinuation.indexByteLimitScope: Per individual input index; this projection assumes accumulation into one retained seed index
capacityDailyContinuation.indexProjectionBasis: Canonical compact merged inventory with current exact experiment entry lengths; extra whitespace, revisions and changed versions can exhaust the bound sooner

observationScenarios.basis: conditional repetition of maximum retained same-day prospective captures

unchangedCurrentBase.scope: This boundary holds only while these exact base bytes remain unchanged. The separate committed-base reader permits an explicitly reviewed committed replacement; it does not generate or schedule that replacement.

workflowInspection.scope: Literal inspected workflow definitions only. A declared schedule does not establish default-branch activation. This projection does not inspect archive restore/append execution receipts; those are separate evidence. Indirect commands or unfamiliar YAML require review.

remainingOperationalRequirements: Actually capture, publish and durably preserve each future issuance and its raw outcomes
An actually activated reviewed trigger and successful remote archive append/readback on the daily path; definitions alone cannot prove continuous operation
Reviewed committed base updates before the unchanged-base request boundary
A bounded archival/streaming design that preserves all required evidence beyond current flat inventory limits
First twelve exact-bound nonoverlapping actual windows with all selected outcomes; no substitution or retrospective issues

zipVerification.scope: ZIP digest, CRC, extraction path safety and download identity are separate caller-provided evidence.

limitations.reviewOmission: Gemini opposition and follow-up reverse review remain omitted-by-user.
